title: Translation of a function's domain
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\alpha$ be a type, let $f:(\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^n\to\alpha$, and fix $z\in(\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^n$. The translated function sends each $x\in(\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^n$ to $f(x+z)$.
